title: Traveller Club Standing and the Release Bonus on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
# Air Ticket Fare Brands: Traveller Club Standing and the Release Bonus

A traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club bears on the terms of Air Ticket Fare Brands in the following way. Two records are read, and no rule of that programme is restated here: the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club card, for its tier and for whether it is active, and the air-ticket accruals standing on that card's points ledger, counted over the last twelve months. The air-accrual threshold is 2. What club standing settles is an uplift added to the pool available to the traveller.

1. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador tiers, and air-ticket accruals standing on its ledger over the last twelve months come to 2 or more, a release bonus of 0.1 is added as an uplift to the pool available to the traveller.
2. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of the Blue, Silver or Gold tiers, and air-ticket accruals standing on its ledger over the last twelve months come to 2 or more, a release bonus of 0.06 is added as an uplift to the pool available to the traveller.
3. Where the traveller holds an active traveller club card of any tier, and air-ticket accruals standing on its ledger over the last twelve months come to fewer than 2, a release bonus of 0.03 is added as an uplift to the pool available to the traveller.
4. Where none of those conditions is met, and in particular where the traveller holds no active traveller club card, no release bonus is added to the pool available to the traveller.

Either side of the air-accrual threshold: on an active Ambassador card carrying exactly 2 air-ticket accruals over the last twelve months the threshold is met and the release bonus added as an uplift to the pool available to the traveller is 0.1, while the same card carrying 1 such accrual falls below the threshold and the release bonus is 0.03. On an active Silver card, 2 air-ticket accruals over the last twelve months give a release bonus of 0.06 and 1 such accrual gives 0.03. A card that is not active satisfies none of the conditions, and no release bonus is added to the pool available to the traveller.
